name: USA for UNHCR
summary: The US non-profit (United States Association for UNHCR, founded 1989) that raises money from Americans for UNHCR, the UN refugee agency, and passes it on as grants to UNHCR's operations abroad, with donated clothes, hygiene kits, software and transport, and public awareness work. UNHCR runs the programmes: cash and relief, shelter, health care, registration and protection, education, livelihoods, resettlement and returns. Modelled on USA for UNHCR's 2025 Form 990 (its audited statements on its website are behind a bot check).

spending.source: https://gt990datalake-rawdata.s3.amazonaws.com/EfileData/XmlFiles/202622319349300112_public.xml (Form 990 for January-December 2025, filed August 2026, financial statements audited: Part IX line 25 programme services $63,325,785 of total functional expenses $95,541,311; management $5,590,837, fundraising $26,624,689)

lines.label: Grants to UNHCR, gifts in kind and refugee awareness
lines.source: https://gt990datalake-rawdata.s3.amazonaws.com/EfileData/XmlFiles/202622319349300112_public.xml (Form 990 2025, Part III: programme 1, cash grants to UNHCR's refugee programmes, $44,326,241 ($44.05M wired to UNHCR in eight regions per Schedule F, $82,250 to US refugee groups and $192,300 to individuals per Schedule I); programme 2, gifts in kind, $10,810,376, of which $10,626,878 donated goods passed on; programme 3, refugee awareness activities, $8,189,168). One line because charityevals models the three as branches of one model (Convention 4); the donated goods enter that model's credit share rather than its cost.
